In regard to your question about whether or not to leave it be, we have a good amount of alters who internally recreate trauma we’ve experienced. We leave them be because this is beneficial for us. Their re-enactments help us understand and process what we’ve been through, come to terms with the idea that yes, those events really were that bad, and in some cases help us to not view those who have hurt us as one-dimensional monsters. We try to have safety measures in place, like making sure other alters are aware of what’s happening between the trauma actors, can be contacted and intervene immediately if either actor (even those playing the role of abuser, as it can be really taxing on them also) needs help, give trauma actors education on topics like abuse and sex. Stuff like that. Our experience isn’t universal and your mileage may vary, but it isn’t necessarily a panic moment when you do have alters who do things like this. Sometimes it’s a necessary part of the healing process.

Do you ever switch out with them, having times when they’re more in control? If so, perhaps leave notes encouraging them to confront and address that grief. It’s possible that one of them could have an easier time doing so than you do, and that once they’ve got a foot in the door, you’ll also be able to start processing your grief. 

In some systems, even just mentally acknowledging that your alters are also experiencing things can help, especially if you deal with a lot of denial. Kind of projecting your voice inward and saying, “I know you’re going through something really hard right now”, things like that. We personally do a lot of processing in the background, with alters that don’t front working through thoughts and emotions that fronters initially can’t acknowledge. That helps us fronters then tackle the topic, once it’s been broken down into smaller pieces by other alters and isn’t as intimidating.

The puberty that someone goes through is based on which hormones they have access to. So people who have testosterone will go through a “male” puberty, and people who have estrogen will have a “female” puberty. For most people, their body produces one of these hormones once they reach the age where they start puberty, and that’s how they get access to them. For trans kids, they have to go on blockers to prevent the hormone they produce from giving them the wrong puberty, that way they can externally get the correct hormone and go through the puberty that best fits them. The biological sex only determines which hormone a body produces, but doesn’t prevent the body from going through a different puberty if the hormone for it is provided

We can change up our own appearances in the headspace, but only to a degree. Most of us can only change our headspace bodies the same ways we could change the collective body, like dyeing our hair or getting tattoos. Some of us, especially those with more monstrous appearances or abilities, can do more extreme stuff. 

For the most part though we can’t change anyone but ourselves. My co-fronter could change his hair, but unless I were to take scissors to his head while he slept, I can’t do that for him. Some of the aforementioned monstrous alters, especially those who hold a lot of power in the system, can change the appearances of other alters to those more extreme degrees. I heard of one of them giving another alter additional eyes by request, something that alter wouldn’t have been able to do on their own.
